summary.ko: 동일 성장·장비와 5카드+용병1명 편성의 서버 시뮬레이션에서 블루기어 SS 5종은 기존 SS 리미티드27종보다 우위, 라자크와 동급. 라자크보다 확실한 상위로 설정된 것은 아스트라·제로·하쿠야다.

pvp.conditions: Current production CMS/runtime/growth; 13 matched five-card deck/magic/growth/equipment scenarios, 32 fixed seeds each with both attacker and defender positions. No pets or class advancement. Equipment uses equal neutral power, no item-specific set effects. Team simulations, not real player win rates.
pvp.ssConditions: All current non-Blue-Gear SS LIMITED catalog identities; four equal growth/deck/equipment scenarios, eight seeds with both A/B sides per matchup; actual server team battle function.

pve.conditions: Actual createPveBattleV2 server function; single boss is_boss=1, power 1e13; first 18 completed mercenary actions (six skills plus twelve basics), target still alive. Four equal level/deck/magic/equipment scenarios, eight shared seeds. This removes total-HP-at-kill saturation from whole-battle damage. This is a matched action sample, not real-time DPS or an all-monster guarantee.
measurementNotes: Initial pve-matchups.json is invalid: publicFighter strips damageDealt. It is preserved in operations as measurement history, not used for conclusions.
Whole-fight totals in pve-matchups-v2.json saturate when a target dies. Ranking uses pve-rotation.json: identical first18 completed actions, six skills and twelve basics, with target still alive.
Timeline special-skill damage comes from hits[].damage and hits[].absorbed. Aggregate direct event fields alone omit those special-skill hits.
Single-boss action comparison does not establish superiority in every multi-enemy raid, synergy, pet, class advancement or equipment set.

blueGear.existingSsPriority: Same prebattle priority policy as Razak; disabled against Blue Gear or mixed opposing higher-tier mercenaries.

performance.condition: Windows CLI, actual production read services, network included, first/repeat only, no runtime changes or speed improvement claim.
performance.bottleneck: Measured production read services are dominated by network/DB round trips; first/repeat are single samples and vary. No query or execution path changed.
performance.visualScope: Balance/configuration audit only; no UI or rendering change. No new browser/device loading or frame measurements, and no runtime speed or FPS improvement claim.
